scope: Taskboard rename/delete, dependency integrity, concurrent board mutation, and human membership revocation

checks.name: Concurrent first imports
checks.evidence: Second writer observed waiting on advisory lock; both task IDs persisted and event sequences are 1 and 2.

checks.name: Subtree deletion versus concurrent child creation
checks.evidence: Child writer observed waiting on advisory lock; deletion succeeds, child creation rejects TASKBOARD_TASK_NOT_FOUND, zero remaining tasks and one delete event.

checks.name: External dependency rejection
checks.evidence: Deleting referenced subtree rejects RESOURCE_CONFLICT without task/event mutation; unlinking dependency then deletes root and child while dependent remains.

checks.name: Queued editor write versus membership removal
checks.evidence: Actual SpaceService.removeMemberAs holds uncommitted removal; editor eager check sees old membership, waits on shared Space advisory lock, then rejects SPACE_ACCESS_DENIED after removal commits. No board/task/event inserted.

redRegression.name: Queued editor write versus membership removal
redRegression.beforeFix: failed: expected advisory lock wait, received false

serializableComparison.note: Old Serializable version passed the controlled concurrency test; do not claim a reproduced P2002. ReadCommitted now makes post-lock statements see the latest committed board while the shared Space lock serializes all board writers.

frontend.evidence: Save updates card/detail title; confirmed subtree deletion refreshes cards; cancellation sends no DELETE; dependency conflict is explained.

limitations: Agent grant/credential revocation semantics were not changed by this taskboard fix.
Parent task performs the final whole-candidate build and typecheck.
